connect.title: Connect Binance
connect.subtitle: Billetera reads your balances and movements with a read-only Binance key.
connect.stepsTitle: Create a read-only key in Binance
connect.step1: In your Binance account, open API Management and create a new API key.
connect.step2: Turn on Enable Reading, and leave trading, withdrawals and transfers off.
connect.step3: Paste the API key and the secret below.
connect.checking: Checking the key with Binance. This can take a few seconds.

hero.title: See where your Binance money goes.
hero.subtitle: billetera reads your Binance balances and movements with a read-only API key, so you can label your spending and see your history in USD.
hero.readOnly: Only read-only Binance keys are accepted.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.body: Your total balance in USD, the change since yesterday, this month's spending by category, and your top holdings.

label.title: Label your spending
label.body: Say what each payment was for, with a category and a reason, straight from the dashboard.

movements.title: Movements
movements.body: The full history of deposits, withdrawals, Pay transfers, P2P and Convert, with filters, search and CSV export.

assets.body: Every coin across Spot and Funding, with its balance history.

one.title: Sign up
one.body: Create an account with your email and a password.

two.title: Connect Binance
two.body: Create a read-only API key in Binance and paste it in. billetera checks it with Binance and refuses it if it can do more than read.

three.title: See your money
three.body: The first sync brings your last 90 days of movements, and billetera keeps syncing every hour.

security.title: Your money stays where it is

readOnly.title: Read-only, enforced
readOnly.body: A key that can trade, withdraw or transfer is refused when you save it. billetera can't move your funds.

encrypted.title: Encrypted at rest
encrypted.body: Your key and secret are encrypted with AES-256-GCM. After you save them, only a masked form is shown.

restrict.title: Restrict it further
restrict.body: In Binance, you can limit the key to an IP address. Settings tells you whether yours is limited.

control.title: You stay in control
control.body: Remove the key at any time, and syncing stops. Disabling the key in Binance also cuts access.

moveMoney.question: Can billetera move or withdraw my money?
moveMoney.answer: No. Only read-only keys are accepted, so billetera can't trade, withdraw or transfer.

spending.question: What counts as spending?
spending.answer: Money leaving Binance: withdrawals, P2P sales and Pay transfers you send. Converting one coin to another isn't spending, and deposits aren't counted.

history.question: How far back does it go?
history.answer: 90 days of movements on the first sync. Balance history starts the day you connect.

frequency.question: How often does it update?
frequency.answer: Every hour on its own, or now with Sync.

usd.question: Where do the USD values come from?
usd.answer: Binance's public prices at the minute of each movement. Some coins have no price, and the app says so instead of guessing.

removeKey.question: What happens if I remove my key?
removeKey.answer: Syncing stops. Your balances, movements and labels stay.
